purpose: Test the V53 common high-backbone diagnosis by retaining the full-information V50 bounded mixture and changing only its train score: add fixed train-only physical-density exceedance Brier terms to the unchanged proper bounded negative log likelihood, require train high-backbone physical-moment calibration before development sampling, and retain all independent-data firewalls.

single_changed_factor.V50_objective: equal-source mean exact bounded-logit five-component Gaussian-mixture negative log likelihood
single_changed_factor.V54_objective: the identical V50 negative log likelihood plus 0.1 times the arithmetic mean of four fixed normalized physical-density exceedance Brier scores

train_only_threshold_selection.source: every native 64^3 physical target y in the immutable train split, independently in TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift
train_only_threshold_selection.per_domain_rule: exact NumPy linear empirical quantile of every finite native train log10rho value
train_only_threshold_selection.common_threshold_rule: at each probability use the exact median of the three per-domain train quantiles
train_only_threshold_selection.normalized_Brier_weight: one divided by q times (1-q) for each fixed quantile probability q

proper_tail_score.event: observed physical log10rho strictly exceeds the fixed common train-only threshold
proper_tail_score.prediction: P_model(log10rho exceeds threshold | all seven unchanged V50 condition fields), computed by the analytic bounded-mixture CDF at the voxelwise residual threshold
proper_tail_score.outside_support_rule: probability is exactly one when the physical threshold maps at or below the lower residual support and exactly zero when it maps at or above the upper residual support; the observed event is then necessarily identical because every train target is strictly inside support
proper_tail_score.per_threshold_score: (predicted exceedance probability - binary observed event)^2 divided by q times (1-q)
proper_tail_score.tail_score: arithmetic mean over the four fixed thresholds and all batch voxels
proper_tail_score.properness: each fixed-threshold Brier score is proper for its exceedance event and the unchanged bounded NLL is strictly proper for the full conditional density; their positive fixed sum remains strictly proper

likelihood_and_network.likelihood: unchanged V50 five-component Gaussian mixture in latent x=logit((z-lower)/(upper-lower)) with exact Jacobian
likelihood_and_network.architecture: unchanged V50 seven-channel three-dimensional residual U-Net
likelihood_and_network.structure_risk_channel: unchanged observed train-only cached V41 full extreme-structure block probability

training.mixed_precision: unchanged CUDA autocast plus GradScaler; bounded NLL and analytic CDF score remain float32 or safer
training.augmentation: the same uniformly selected 48 signed cube isometries applied jointly to all seven conditions, physical backbone, and target
training.validation: fixed diagnostic NLL, tail Brier score, and composite score at steps 4000, 8000, and 12000; never used for stopping, threshold selection, checkpoint selection, or hyperparameter change

train_mechanism_gate.timing: after the fixed step-12000 checkpoint and before any V54 development sample
train_mechanism_gate.population: the identical V53 seed-146046 train-only 4096-voxel probe per object for 432 TNG100, 202 SIMBA, and 409 Swift objects
train_mechanism_gate.primary: 64-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature of the V54 bounded mixture in the domainwise q99.9-and-above query-backbone stratum
train_mechanism_gate.pass: V54 quadrature-over-truth mean delta squared is independently within [2/3,1.5] in the q99.9-and-above backbone stratum of TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift, with every aggregate 32-to-64 relative difference at most 0.005
train_mechanism_gate.comparison: also report strict improvement relative to sealed V50 and V52 at every backbone stratum without using it as a substitute for the absolute pass
train_mechanism_gate.failure_action: seal failure and do not create any V54 development sample

sampling_if_train_mechanism_passes.candidate: same-voxel monotone bounded-mixture CDF inversion of the unchanged paired V31 donor conditional-rank field using actual V54 query-local parameters
sampling_if_train_mechanism_passes.inverse: unchanged 28-step latent Gaussian-mixture inverse at rank epsilon 1e-7 followed by the exact frozen sigmoid support transform
sampling_if_train_mechanism_passes.post_sample: undo immutable V45 standardization and apply one exact residual DC projection before adding the unchanged query backbone
sampling_if_train_mechanism_passes.control: periodically roll all 15 V54 latent parameter fields by (16,8,4) native voxels while retaining the query, backbone, and donor rank

development_evaluation_if_train_mechanis.primary_pass: candidate passes field, Q3, and Q4 independently in every domain
development_evaluation_if_train_mechanis.sealed_references: V50 full-risk and V52 no-risk decisions and artifact hashes only; neither is resampled
development_evaluation_if_train_mechanis.selection_role: only the V54 query-local candidate can be selected

fixed_branches.condition: the train mechanism gate fails in any domain
the train mechanism gate passes and the development primary_pass holds
the train mechanism gate passes, Q3 and Q4 pass every development domain, but any field check fails

the train mechanism gate passes and V54 strictly improves absolute q99.999 error, maximum excess, and absolute log mean-delta-squared ratio over both sealed references in every domain but primary_pass is false
the train mechanism gate passes but V50 or V52 equals or improves V54 in all three extreme comparisons in every domain
the train mechanism gate passes and the rolled parameter control equals or improves candidate Q3 and Q4 jointly in every domain
